title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions change when it is trained on different datasets. Reducing variance often involves simplifying the model or using techniques that prevent overfitting.

title: Feature Transformation
text: Transforming features can help in reducing model variance. Consider transformations that simplify the relationship between the feature and the target variable.
